purpose: return bounded sanitized logs for one authorized container.

source.source_text: Purpose: return bounded sanitized logs for one authorized container. Input: container_id:string, tail?:1..5000, since_seconds?:integer. Output: log lines, time range, truncation. Contract: L2 read_only; scope mac.docker.read; target container_id; timeout 15000ms; cap 1MiB; local Docker only; no filesystem; credential/secret-pattern redaction mandatory; approval trusted_read; idempotent yes. Phase 3 planned.
